scenarios.title: Database connection pool saturation
scenarios.symptom: Checkout latency is above 2 seconds and database connections are exhausted.

ground_truth.summary: A deployment reduced the checkout connection-pool limit, exhausting available database connections.

remediation.description: Roll back checkout-api to the last healthy release and restore its connection-pool limit.
remediation.risk: Briefly returns checkout-api to the previous application version.

signals.traces: checkout spans spend 2.4s waiting for a database connection
signals.deployments: checkout-api v2.4.1 deployed 6 minutes before the alert; pool limit changed 40 -> 10

scenarios.title: Deployment regression in checkout
scenarios.symptom: Checkout errors increased immediately after the latest release.

ground_truth.summary: Release v3.8.0 introduced an unindexed query that drives database CPU and checkout latency.

remediation.description: Roll checkout-api back from v3.8.0 to the last healthy release v3.7.4.
remediation.risk: Reverts checkout-api application behavior to v3.7.4.

signals.traces: checkout spans show query get_cart_items at 2.8s; query plan uses sequential scan
signals.logs: ERROR query timeout in get_cart_items; request_id=sim-req-380
signals.deployments: checkout-api v3.8.0 deployed 4 minutes before alert; previous healthy version v3.7.4
signals.sql: get_cart_items scans 1.8M rows; no index on cart_items.customer_id

scenarios.title: Cache cluster unavailable
scenarios.symptom: Catalog requests are slow and the primary database is receiving a sudden traffic spike.

ground_truth.summary: The catalog cache cluster became unavailable, sending cache misses through to the primary database.

remediation.description: Fail the catalog cache traffic over to the healthy replica and warm the hot-key set.
remediation.risk: Cache entries will rebuild gradually and database load may remain elevated briefly.

signals.traces: catalog spans show cache connection refused followed by a slow database read
signals.logs: ERROR cache client connection refused by cache-primary-1
signals.deployments: no catalog-api or cache configuration deployment in the last 60 minutes
signals.sql: catalog read query volume is 4.2x baseline; query latency remains normal

scenarios.title: Payments upstream timeout
scenarios.symptom: Payment requests are timing out while local service health remains normal.

ground_truth.summary: The external payments provider is responding beyond the gateway timeout budget.

remediation.description: Enable the bounded payments-provider circuit breaker and queue retryable requests.
remediation.risk: Some payment requests will be deferred until the provider recovers.

signals.traces: outbound call payments-provider /charge p99=12.4s; local handler p99=45ms
signals.logs: WARN upstream payments-provider exceeded 10s deadline; local dependencies healthy
signals.deployments: no payments-gateway deployment in the last 60 minutes
signals.sql: payments ledger query p95=18ms; connection pool utilization=24%
